_comment: What check-retired.mjs refuses to find on a built page OUTSIDE an element marked data-retired. Each entry is a system that stopped, the day it stopped, and the phrases that only ever described it as RUNNING. A phrase belongs here when it is a present-tense claim or a figure that only made sense while the thing ran; a mere NAME does not, because a past-tense sentence naming a retired system is honest. Add an entry the day something retires. Operator's answer, 2026-09-25: a daily check fails the build if anything retired is described as live.
